component.name: cbonsai
component.summary: Grow bonsai trees in your terminal

description.p: cbonsai is an advanced bonsai tree generator for the terminal, with seasonal color changes, procedural leaf generation, and support for persistent real-time growth. Trees automatically adapt their colors based on the current season and can be configured to grow live, over a fixed time, or over days and weeks between runs.
This implementation began as a fork of John Allbritten's cbonsai and has since diverged with a rewritten growth engine, procedural foliage, structural trunks, and seasonal color palettes.
